reason: The plugin’s core purpose is to provide a DSH session-header wallet control for one-click viewing of DeepSeek API balance. Evidence shows it injects a small UI element into the session header and serves balance data via a host endpoint that reads a local credentials file and calls DeepSeek’s balance API.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 会话顶部加入一个小钱包控件，点击后可快速查看 DeepSeek API 余额。
summaries.en: Adds a compact wallet control in the DSH session header that lets users view their DeepSeek API balance with one click.

capabilities: Reads local host credentials file for DeepSeek API key
Fetches balance data from external DeepSeek API endpoint
Renders/injects a wallet control in the DSH session header

reasons.code: README documents a host endpoint GET /api/wallet/balance that reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml and queries https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance.
README states the wallet UI is implemented as a slot component in conversation.session.header.utilities to show balance in the session header.
package.json includes DSH web client runtime/connection/ui slot injection configuration for web platform.

capabilities: Reads local host credentials file for DeepSeek API key
